_comment: Generic template for the common mcpServers JSON config shape used by several MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, etc). Jules' own MCP config format may differ -- check Jules' current documentation before assuming this shape applies directly.

godot._comment_alternative_mkdevkit: If using the default mkdevkit/godot-mcp instead, its connection is WebSocket-based (client <-stdio/MCP-> Node.js server <-WebSocket:6505-> Godot editor plugin) -- check that repo's own README for its exact client config shape, since it differs from the simple npx-launch pattern shown above for Coding-Solo's server.
